word.item: For name they call me Trufena Shavanga
And my words that I want to say
I am saying words that were of the past
I am saying in the past before we were born, our fathers were putting on something that they call, it cover from skin/
They were taking and putting it infront for someone to pass.
Again they will return and put here at back.
when someone comes from back here, they put there that cow skin.
And time that we were children, those children before being born.
our fathers were telling us they were sleeping on charf, that is called leaves.
They were not sleeping on something, they were just sleeping on leaves.
they were just people who sleep then they cover themselves with another leaf.
then it gets to dawn those days there was trouble.
people were not putting on clothes.
They were not people of putting on clothes.
but these days world has changed.
Our children that wer are giving birth to are putting on clothes.
They are taking tea, now we, those people that were of the past they were covering themselves with sacks.
It is work that was there those days.
They were not cooking vegetables of salt.
They were cooking using something that is called musume.
it is what was cooking it is what they were using to cook.
So people that were of the past our grandparents, that work is what they had.
Again I continue or mmh just continue.
And then something called oil was not there.
People were just applying on mud.
then it happens that mud is the oil that they want to apply on.
and now when you take back children ot that world it will not be possible.
Again we were eating ugali from sorghum.
Maize became available when white people came.
they have ended I have finished.
